data.title: bn-28d: Replace RIBBIT RECOIL backdrop shimmer with palette dimming

data.reason: Approved: stable ENV_DIM remapping removes the full-screen halftone shimmer while preserving a clear foreground hierarchy. Independent environment review and continuity scenarios pass; color and grayscale stills read cleanly. Draw tracing confirms dim mappings occur before the map, the map palette is identity, no dim signature remains post-map, and post-map sprites are identity-scoped. Focused environment/readability regressions pass with zero dropped events.
